device.modelDescription: composes echo-device-module and transform-demo's actions in-process over the worker message channel, with per-hop metering

actionList.name: run
actionList.description: Uppercases the input text via transform-demo, then round-trips the result through echo-device-module's echo action, all in-process over the worker message channel (no HTTP, no model-context round trip for the intermediate steps). Returns the final text plus a call-chain bill with one independent metering record per inner module invoked.
